points.description: Basin order: states that it is the highest stream order found in the basin (i.e., the order of the main/largest stream at the outlet).
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says basin order relates to the order of streams in the basin without saying highest.

points.description: Channel order: states that it is the order of an individual stream/channel segment, based on which order of streams have joined it (its position in the network).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it is the order of a stream/channel without linking to joining streams.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating, in any wording, that basin order is the highest stream order in the basin and channel order is the order of a particular stream segment depending on the streams joining it. Give part marks for a vague or one-sided distinction. Give none for unrelated or wrong definitions. Extra remarks do not lose marks unless they contradict these ideas.
